The '''Council Hall bubble''' was a habitation bubble of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]]. It contained the [[High Board Room/Legends|High Tower Boardroom]], from which the [[Gungan High Council/Legends|Gungan High Council]] governed its people.
